items.title: Ran Blake interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 16, 2021
items.q: in front of me was Iola Brubeck. And she said, “Kids, don’t worry, we’re not going to crash.”

ctx.x: I don’t think so. But he said now Iola said no one’s going to want to do this piece, it’s too sad. And you know it was an interesting moment. And I wonder if you have people who will comment on your music as it’s in progress.

Yes sometimes I don’t play it because a lot of social life has been curtailed and Aaron has released a few video performances here that took place a lot during early last winter. I’ve gotten some general positive feedback but I think with everybody’s situation and maybe they’re hearing really the very big names in music, sometimes it’s ignored. I don’t really get a definite feedback. I’ve also tried to write a piece or two that’s happy but that’s much harder. But Dave Brubeck, I’d love to hear that. A little side…
She was. And she was a big part of his career.
